text: Implemented configuration-driven native EyeLink samples under a named EDF2ASC canonical column convention: exact BigDecimal timestamps/coordinates, left/right/binocular preservation, distinct GAZE/HREF/RAW modes, Area/Diameter/Undocumented/Unspecified pupil representations, explicit dot-gaze-not-blink and zero-pupil-missing policies, optional velocity/resolution/input/buttons/status/head-target fields, frame-checked GAZE-only pixel materialization with off-surface classification, and block-local strict timestamp order. Generated court covers 3 eye layouts x 3 coordinate modes x all 64 optional-column subsets. Evidence: JVM and Scala.js lexical+block+sample suites each pass 29/29; scalafmt gates pass. Mutation proof converted zero pupil to Measured and the missingness test failed, then restoration returned both platforms green.
